title: English Practice Quiz 0131
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: When I was five, I ___ swim.
You did not hear someone. You say:
questions.explanation: Could you repeat that, please? is a polite request.

questions.question: Read: 'Mina takes the bus at 8 a.m. and reaches work at 8:45.' How does Mina travel?
questions.explanation: The passage clearly says Mina takes the bus.

questions.question: To confirm an instruction, you can say:
options: Could you please confirm the details?
questions.explanation: Could you please confirm... is polite and precise.

questions.question: Which is a complete sentence?
questions.explanation: The team finished the work contains a subject and a complete predicate.

questions.question: If you heat ice, it ___.
questions.explanation: The zero conditional uses present simple for general truths.

questions.question: She said, 'I can swim.'
options: She said that she could swim.
questions.explanation: Can commonly changes to could in reported speech after a past reporting verb.

questions.question: The test was ___ than I expected.
I want ___ English fluently.
questions.explanation: Want is followed by a to-infinitive.

questions.question: Choose the correct comparative form.
questions.explanation: The comparative form of the short adjective tall is taller.
